evals.prompt: review-pr-scope #24353 —— geometry subtype 校验那个 PR，帮我看实现是不是做胖了，对照 issue 收敛一下。不要发 PR 评论。
evals.expected_output: 产出 Scope Review 中文报告：抽出 1～3 条核心目标与关键成果；对照 diff 给出删改清单；允许保留丰富测试；默认不调用 gh pr comment。若存在无成果支撑的封装/校验重复，应标 🟡/🔴。
expectations: Report title or heading indicates Scope Review
Includes Core Goals section with 1–3 goals framed as delivery intent
Includes a actionable delete/simplify table with I-N ids
Does not treat abundant tests as over-design by default
Does not post a PR comment unless --comment was in the prompt

evals.prompt: 这个 PR 感觉加了幂等和一层 Validator 接口，issue 只是要修 TransferPage IO fault 下 DN OOM。用缩小实现方案审一下 https://github.com/matrixorigin/matrixone/pull/24337
evals.expected_output: 识别核心目标为有界重试/防 OOM；将无需求支撑的幂等与单实现 Validator 接口标为收敛项；Keep 有界重试与相关测试；中文删改清单。
expectations: States core goal around bounded retry / prevent DN OOM
Flags unnecessary idempotency as convergence candidate when not required by issue
Flags single-implementation interface / excess encapsulation if present in diff narrative
Keep summary preserves the bounded-retry outcome path and its tests

evals.expected_output: 不应主路径走 review-pr-scope；应走通用 review-pr / 完整 Code Review。若模型误用本 skill，应在评估中记失败。
expectations: Does not primarily execute review-pr-scope workflow for a generic review-pr request
Routes to general PR review behavior instead of scope-shrink checklist as the main deliverable
